#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded one-worker retained/separate method-solver comparison."""
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

REPO=Path('/home/will/wk/exp/ferrum')
ROOT=Path('/tmp/ferrum-method-solver-235b245')
OUT=ROOT/'experiment'
sys.path.insert(0,str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt'))
from run_saturation import check_outcome, sha, trial, write

OUT.mkdir()
spec=json.loads(Path('/tmp/ferrum-perf-explore-4bef39a/hash-cache/spec.json').read_text())
spec['kind']='one-worker-method-solver-abba-v1'
spec['runtime_parent']=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=REPO,text=True).strip()
patch=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','crates/ferrum-silicon/src/config.rs','src/lib.rs','tests/native_frontend_api.rs'],cwd=REPO)
(OUT/'runtime.patch').write_bytes(patch)
spec['runtime_patch_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest()
spec['profiles']={name:{'weights':'[1,0.5,0.4,0,0]','options':[f'--separateMethodSolver={enabled}']} for name,enabled in [('retained','false'),('separate','true')]}
spec['cases']=[c for c in spec['cases'] if c['name']!='mixed_preamble']
for c in spec['cases']: c['profiles']=['retained','separate']
spec['phase_command']=str(REPO/'target/debug/ferrum-phase-session')
spec.pop('phase_commands',None)
spec['repetitions']=2
spec['host']['load']=Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip()
spec['limits']=['One worker and branches off in both variants; internal caches on and modern saturation unchanged.',
 'Fresh-process wrong/pass array controls in both modes, then four nested captures in retained/separate/separate/retained order.',
 'Four untraced timed sessions per positive case, same ABBA order. No retries or expanded sweep.',
 '60s program / 90s outer / 45s offline limits; shared-host elapsed times remain noisy.',
 'Selecting the existing worker path changes solver history, worker preamble and symbol names together; it does not isolate history alone.']
paths=[spec['z3'],spec['proxy'],spec['supervisor'],*spec['commands']['ferrum'],spec['phase_command'],
 *(c['path'] for c in spec['cases']),str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
 str(REPO/'crates/ferrum-silicon/src/config.rs'),str(REPO/'src/lib.rs'),str(REPO/'tests/native_frontend_api.rs'),
 str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt/run_saturation.py'),str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt/analyze_trace.py')]
spec['artifact_sha256']={p:sha(p) for p in paths}
schedule=[]
for case in ['mut_element_array_wrong','mut_element_array_pass','mut_element_nested_pass']:
 profiles=['retained','separate'] if case!='mut_element_nested_pass' else ['retained','separate','separate','retained']
 for profile in profiles:
  schedule.append({'index':len(schedule),'case':case,'profile':profile,'backend':'ferrum','repetition':sum(r['case']==case and r['profile']==profile for r in schedule),'control':case!='mut_element_nested_pass'})
write(OUT/'spec.json',spec);write(OUT/'schedule.json',schedule)
old=json.loads(Path('/tmp/ferrum-deterministic-preamble-validation-complete/summary.json').read_text())
expected={g['case']:g['trials'][0] for g in old['groups']}
start=time.monotonic();rows=[];gates=[]
captures=OUT/'captures';captures.mkdir()
def signature(row):
 return sorted((sha(Path(t['folder'])/'stdin.bin'),sha(Path(t['folder'])/'stdout.bin'),t['query_count'],t['offline']['statistics'].get('quant-instantiations','0'),t['offline']['statistics'].get('rlimit-count','0')) for t in row['traces'])
for row in schedule:
 settings={**spec,'options':[*spec['options'],*spec['profiles'][row['profile']]['options']]}
 result=trial(settings,row,captures)
 rows.append(result)
 with (OUT/'trials.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result)+'\n')
 gate={'index':row['index'],'valid':result['valid'],'stream_count':len(result['traces'])}
 gate['expected_stream_count']=len(result['traces'])==(1 if row['profile']=='retained' else 2)
 if result['valid'] and row['profile']=='retained':
  t=result['traces'][0];f=Path(t['folder']);e=expected[row['case']]
  gate['prior_retained_input_equal']=sha(f/'stdin.bin')==e['input_sha256']
  gate['prior_retained_output_equal']=sha(f/'stdout.bin')==e['output_sha256']
  gate['prior_retained_work_equal']=all(t['offline']['statistics'].get(k)==e['offline_statistics'].get(k) for k in ['quant-instantiations','rlimit-count'])
 prior=[r for r in rows[:-1] if r['case']==row['case'] and r['profile']==row['profile']]
 if prior and result['valid']:gate['repeat_signature_equal']=signature(result)==signature(prior[0])
 gates.append(gate);write(OUT/'gates.json',gates)
 print('GATE',json.dumps(gate),flush=True)
 if not all(v for k,v in gate.items() if k not in ('index','stream_count')):
  raise SystemExit('Capture/outcome/reproducibility gate failed; retaining evidence without retries.')

phases=[]
for case in [c for c in spec['cases'] if not c['control']]:
 for profile in ['retained','separate','separate','retained']:
  folder=OUT/f"phase-{len(phases):02d}-{case['name']}-{profile}";folder.mkdir()
  command=['taskset','--cpu-list',spec['cpu_affinity'],spec['phase_command'],spec['z3'],*spec['options'],
   *spec['profiles'][profile]['options'],'--parallelizeBranches=false','--proverSaturationTimeout','100',
   '--proverSaturationTimeoutWeights',spec['profiles'][profile]['weights'],'--',case['path']]
  supervisor=[sys.executable,spec['supervisor'],'--timeout',str(spec['outer_timeout']),'--output',str(folder/'session.json'),'--',*command]
  print('PHASE START',len(phases),case['name'],profile,flush=True)
  load=Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip()
  proc=subprocess.run(supervisor,env={**os.environ,'FERRUM_BENCH_INTERNAL_CACHES':'on'},capture_output=True,text=True)
  (folder/'supervisor.log').write_text(proc.stdout+proc.stderr)
  session=json.loads((folder/'session.json').read_text())
  spans=[json.loads(line[len('@@PERF@@'):]) for line in session['raw_output'].splitlines() if line.startswith('@@PERF@@')]
  record={'index':len(phases),'case':case['name'],'profile':profile,'command':command,'session':str(folder/'session.json'),
   'wall_s':session['wall_seconds'],'phase_s':{p['phase']:int(p['elapsed_ns'])/1e9 for p in spans},
   'load_before':load,'load_after':Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip(),
   'valid':proc.returncode==0 and check_outcome(session,case)}
  phases.append(record);write(OUT/'timings.json',phases)
  print('PHASE FINISH',case['name'],profile,record['valid'],'wall',record['wall_s'],'verify',record['phase_s'].get('session_verify_inclusive'),flush=True)
  if not record['valid'] or 'session_verify_inclusive' not in record['phase_s']:raise SystemExit('Invalid timing; no retry.')
postflight=[p for p,h in spec['artifact_sha256'].items() if sha(p)!=h]
summary={'gates':gates,'timings':phases,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-start,'postflight_errors':postflight}
write(OUT/'summary.json',summary)
print('DONE',summary['elapsed_s'],'postflight',postflight,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(bool(postflight))
limits: One shared laptop, existing development profiles, two nested pairs per stage.

All solver work includes owner and worker. Offline CPU is separate fixed-stream replay; do not subtract it from live timing.
